import EnvTable from '../../../../components/EnvTable.astro';
import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Each app has its own `.env`, seeded from its `.env.example` at generation.
`packages/db` has none: Prisma there runs with the API's env, loaded by the
API's `db:*` scripts.

<Aside type="caution" title="Match the API exactly">
The worker's `DATABASE_URL` and `REDIS_*` must point at the **API's** database
and Redis. A wrong Redis is silent: the worker connects fine and never receives
a job.
</Aside>

## apps/api

The same variables as [nest-api](../../nest-api/environment/).

<EnvTable template="nest-monorepo" file="apps/api/.env.example" />

## apps/worker

The same variables as [node-worker](../../node-worker/environment/).
`PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH` ships commented out: the worker image sets it, and
an empty value would replace that path.

<EnvTable template="nest-monorepo" file="apps/worker/.env.example" />
